name: subagent-persona
description: A pi-subagents replace-mode child: boundary, agent tag and a persona carrying its own <rules> and <example> blocks replace the preamble.

toolSnippets.bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
toolSnippets.edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement

<active_agent name="reviewer"/>

</rules>

</example>
